column1: # static_rules.tsv - the one per-file table of `./cbase deploy`'s uploads (static.sh).
# One rule per line, two fields separated by a TAB: a glob and the Content-Type. The glob is matched
# against the file's path in the static dir, lower-cased (no leading slash; * crosses /), and the
# first rule that matches wins; the last, "*", is the fallback.
# Cache-Control is not a column, because it is one rule for every file (static.sh):
#   html (text/html)                     no-cache: a browser and CloudFront revalidate it every time,
#                                        so a deploy's new page is seen at once
#   a content-hashed file (CBASE_HASHED) public, max-age=31536000, immutable: a year, never asked for
#                                        again (its name changes when its bytes do); html never is
# CloudFront compresses only the types on its list ("Serve compressed files" in the CloudFront
# developer guide), objects of 1,000 to 10,000,000 bytes. application/wasm is on it, so a separate
# An extensionless file is matched by its path: Apple reads apple-app-site-association as JSON.
